seed_floor_definition: largest of SD_a, SD_b and the median SD over all arms in the cell (v4 §3.5.8; SD uses ddof=1)

B1.rule: v4 §3.5.9 B1: plain nuisance R2 > anchored in every seed; v4 §3.5.8 requires |delta mean| > 2 x the seed floor (the conservative reading of 'exceeds the seed-floor rule')

R7.rule: v4 §4 R7 (bridge half): anchored nuisance R2 < plain in every paired seed and anchored seed-mean physics_MSE_CRLB per parameter <= 1.1 x plain
